### Which to Pick for a Hangover

- **Choose Liquid I.V. if:** You want mild sweetness that goes down easily in the morning, a small boost of sugar/carbs alongside fluids, or easy availability at local stores.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX6oAtWwO_ubc7KRCLVx5uY4KObje_Yi9Tutmy9V14PSQwNWJTdHe5yK42j-QkFUIepZxGXYyHDZwWE4uqcwJxsB_qsC6o8Fc9vHqKZg1cr3tOdPoRZOjf6bY1m_7PpM_zmg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF19BoerfAivI9ofZ6R1ao7Gj1pcp1vGz9LjixX0z_DpMioNz93Z6jCEZnYBRLjlBuC2SDLDgaFe0MZ31UmLglc9GXbFCemkJ8KIsI54Gp_A3sUfM41NCdUpJ5u6DFELFbn6YwRUmSTt6nw_SdTTMqoKLhz2pOtJlGnpIWWt2q8z2PqDgQzA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXsi2IKhVSPodtw27Wmi2NTyP-f0Mg6ZdA_E0srntDhmBkZZhLbcKySH29UTqlescPex2ToETXqd1q4XKYOoGd90WuiJflMBdhBUhjVF2p7-3CdYgQ-xY7UH7uWCIJcO20kXEsIbYMhTEz)
- **Choose LMNT if:** You want high sodium and some magnesium without added sugar or stevia alternatives—though pairing it with a light carb/snack can help if you want glucose-assisted absorption.
